text: 1、沪指早间震荡调整，创业板指冲高回落。农业股逆势走强，敦煌种业、金健米业涨停。创新药、CRO概念表现活跃，金石亚药、百花医药涨停。汽车整车股拉升，众泰汽车、海马汽车、安凯客车涨停。下跌方面，贵金属板块调整，山东黄金、中金黄金、湖南黄金等跌超6%。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超3100股飘绿，上午半天成交1.25万亿。午间收盘沪指跌0.36%，深成指跌0.29%，创业板跌0.12%。 2、板块概念方面，农业、创新药、汽车整车、教育等板块领涨；贵金属、油气、电力、煤炭等板块领跌。 3、两市共2154只个股上涨，34只个股涨停；2874只个股下跌，1只个股跌停；
text_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite Index fluctuated and adjusted in the morning, while the ChiNext Index surged then pulled back. Agricultural stocks strengthened against the trend, with Dunhuang Seed and Jinjian Cereals Industry hitting the daily limit. Innovative drugs and CRO concepts were active, with Jinshi Pharmaceutical and Baihua Pharmaceutical hitting the daily limit. Auto整车 stocks rallied, with Zotye Auto, Haima Automobile, and Ankai Bus hitting the daily limit. On the downside, the precious metals sector adjusted, with Shandong Gold, China Gold, and Hunan Gold falling over 6%. More stocks fell than rose, with over 3,100 stocks declining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and half-day turnover reaching 1.25 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.36%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.29%, and ChiNext fell 0.12%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, agriculture, innovative drugs, auto整车, and education led gains; precious metals, oil and gas, power, and coal led declines. 3. A total of 2,154 stocks rose, with 34 hitting the daily limit; 2,874 stocks fell, with 1 hitting the daily limit;
